notes.title: UI update
notes.content:
The game shows you basic instructions and a QR code to the app on the screen to make joining the game easier.

We have also limited the number of things you can hold at the same time to avoid unintentional grabbing of objects.

notes.title: The Tutorial Update - 0.4.0
notes.content:
We've just released an update for VR Dungeon. The most important changes are:
[list]
[*]Brand new interactive tutorial
[*]Trading cards, profile backgrounds and emoticons
[*]More treasures
[*]Improved some visual elements
[/list]
If you find any bugs or have any ideas, please give us feedback via our website.

notes.title: The Alchemy Update - 0.3.0
notes.content:
We've just released a new major content update for VR Dungeon. The most important changes are:
[list][*]Brand new puzzle type: Alchemy. Mix colors to create the correct potion!
[*]Fancier torch
[*]Printer-friendly guide (consumes less ink and paper)
[*]Updated hitboxes (it should be easier to grab stuff)
[*]Various bugfixes and performance improvements
[*]Update to the Android app (downloadable in the Play Store)
[/list]

The new Alchemy mode appears randomly, so you don't need to do anything, just play.

The next major update will most likely include a better tutorial and more treasures.

If you find any bugs or have any ideas, please give us feedback via our website.

tags.feature: [*]Brand new puzzle type: Alchemy. Mix colors to create the correct potion!
[*]Update to the Android app (downloadable in the Play Store)

notes.title: Update 0.2.0 - Achiements and more
notes.content:
We have just released a new version (0.2.0 [g8]) of VR Dungeon. This update includes:
[list]
[*]Steamworks integration
[*]Steam achievements
[*]More treasure types
[*]Treasures are easier to find
[/list]
We hope you will enjoy these additions. If you encounter any bugs just send us a mail: relativerealitystudios@gmail.com
